name: Generate from this model
description: One-tap generation widget that drops onto a model page sidebar. No prompt-craft required: pre-loaded with the page's model, just hit Generate.

scopeJustifications.ai:write:budgeted: Runs one image generation per tap from the model page sidebar; each run spends the viewer's Buzz within the publisher's per-generation budget to produce the result shown in the block.
scopeJustifications.buzz:read:self: Reads the viewer's Buzz balance to show the estimated cost on the Generate button and to offer a top-up instead of failing when the balance is below that estimate.

buzz_budget_per_gen.label: Max Buzz per generation
buzz_budget_per_gen.description: Hard cap enforced by the platform. Buzz that exceeds this is rejected before the workflow runs.

default_prompt_suffix.label: Default prompt suffix (optional)
default_prompt_suffix.description: Appended to the user's prompt automatically. Useful for setting style hints (e.g., 'masterpiece, best quality, detailed').

show_advanced.label: Show advanced controls
show_advanced.description: Reveal seed, sampler, and step controls. Off by default for the one-tap UX.
